cone_body.brief: A Japanese road-works traffic cone unrolled: fluorescent red-orange PVC, two white retro-reflective sleeves (one wide band at 55-70% height, one thin band at 30%), faint moulding seams, black tyre scuffs and grey road dust towards the bottom, a few scratches through the reflective film.

cone_base.brief: Recycled black rubber, slightly speckled, with grit and dried mud in the grooves.

bin_body.brief: A tall municipal plastic litter bin unrolled, painted in neutral grey for tinting: vertical moulded ribs every 8 cm, a darker drip line under the lid, scuffs and sun-faded patches, a sticker residue patch, grime collecting at the base.

bin_lid.brief: Charcoal moulded plastic with a fine matte texture, scratches and dust in the corners.

bin_label.brief: A white sorting sticker for a Japanese bin: a coloured header band, large text 'もえるゴミ' (burnable), small icons of paper and food waste, small English 'Burnable', slightly peeled corner, rain stains.

crate_wood.brief: Rough-sawn pine crate planks running horizontally, 10 cm wide boards with gaps, nail heads, saw marks, grey weathering and a faded stencilled lot number.

pallet_wood.brief: A used shipping pallet's boards: heat-treated pine, an 'HT' stamp, dark water stains, forklift gouges, splinters.

barrier_panel.brief: A Japanese road-works barrier panel: diagonal yellow and black stripes, a white plate in the middle reading '工事中' with smaller 'ご迷惑をおかけします', scuffed, a strip of reflective tape, dirt splashes along the bottom.

barrier_frame.brief: Galvanised steel with spangle pattern, white rust spots and scratches.

barrier_foot.brief: Heavy black rubber ballast block, moulded grip texture, worn smooth on top.

bicycle_frame.brief: Glossy painted steel tube in neutral grey for tinting, chips showing grey primer, a few scratches, a small registration sticker (防犯登録).

bicycle_tyre.brief: A bicycle tyre tread unrolled: fine block tread down the middle, smooth sidewall with faint lettering, dust.

bicycle_steel.brief: Chrome-plated steel, slightly pitted, small rust freckles, fingerprints.

bicycle_saddle.brief: Black vinyl saddle cover, stitched seam, cracks from the sun.

bicycle_basket.brief: A wire mamachari basket seen from the front: a grid of steel wires with a rolled rim, on a mid-grey background (the background shows through as the basket's fill).

vending_body.brief: Powder-coated steel cabinet in neutral grey for tinting: panel seams, rivets, sun fading, sticker residue, a dented corner, grime at the bottom.

vending_front.brief: The lit display window of a Japanese drinks vending machine, seen straight on: three shelves of about 10 cans and PET bottles each (green tea, coffee, cola, water, sports drinks - invented brands), small price tags '¥130' / '¥160' under each with blue 'つめた~い' and red 'あたたか~い' labels, a row of round push buttons, slight reflections on the plastic.

vending_panel.brief: The lower half of the vending machine front: coin slot, note acceptor, IC-card reader (contactless logo), change return lever, the wide dark pickup flap 'とりだしぐち', a QR sticker, scratches and finger marks.

vending_trim.brief: Brushed stainless steel kickplate, scuffed by shoes, water stains.

bench_wood.brief: Hardwood park-bench slats along the length, oiled but weathered, grain, rounded edges, carved initials, bird droppings.

bench_iron.brief: Black-painted cast iron with a slight casting texture, paint chips showing rust.

bollard_body.brief: A Japanese steel car-stop bollard unrolled: galvanised grey body, a yellow reflective band near the top, scrape marks from bumpers at 40-60 cm, rust weeping at the base.

lamp_pole.brief: Grey painted steel lamp column: vertical weld seam, faded paint, layers of torn flyer paper and tape residue near head height, rust at the base flange.

lamp_head.brief: Dark grey die-cast aluminium luminaire housing with cooling fins, bird droppings, dust.

lamp_lens.brief: The underside lens of an LED street lamp: a grid of small LED dots behind a frosted diffuser, warm white, slightly dirty edges.

pole_concrete.brief: A Japanese spun-concrete utility pole: light grey with fine pores, faint vertical form lines, climbing-step bolt holes, black grime streaks running down, moss at the bottom.

pole_guard.brief: The yellow-and-black diagonally striped reflective guard wrapped round the base of a utility pole, scuffed by cars.

pole_plate.brief: A tall Japanese utility-pole advertisement plate (電柱広告): a local clinic or real-estate agent's name in big vertical kanji, an arrow, '200m', a phone number, weathered with rust trickles.

pole_metal.brief: Weathered galvanised steel and grey painted metal: bolts, rust staining, a warning sticker.

tree_bark.brief: Street-tree bark (zelkova / plane tree): flaking plates of grey-brown bark with lighter patches, lichen.

tree_leaves.brief: A dense mass of small deciduous leaves seen from a few metres away, varied greens with sunlit and shadowed clusters, tiny gaps.

tree_grate.brief: A square cast-iron tree grate seen from above: radiating slots around a round hole, rust, cigarette butts and leaves caught in it.

planter_box.brief: Precast concrete planter box with exposed aggregate, chipped corners, damp dark stains at the bottom.

planter_shrub.brief: Clipped azalea / box shrubs: tight small dark-green leaves, a few pink flowers.

signpost_pole.brief: Galvanised steel sign post with spangle pattern, stickers half peeled.

sign_face.brief: A Japanese 'no entry' road sign (車両進入禁止): red disc, white horizontal bar, white rim, retro-reflective sheeting texture, slight fading, a small dent. On a transparent-looking light grey square background (only the disc is used).

sign_back.brief: The bare aluminium back of a road sign, brushed, with a stamped maker's label and bolts.

ac_body.brief: Off-white painted steel casing of an aircon outdoor unit, rust streaks from the screws, grime, a faded spec label.

ac_grille.brief: The round fan grille of an aircon outdoor unit seen straight on: concentric wire rings with a dark fan blade behind, dust, rust spots.

ac_fins.brief: Aluminium heat-exchanger fins: very fine vertical slats, bent in places, dusty.

ball_skin.brief: A worn football's panels unrolled (white with black pentagons), scuffed and grass-stained.
